title: Figuring the TRICARE Retired Reserve Retired Reserve Closing Reconciliation
content:
Under the TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, for a TRICARE Retired Reserve plan: The Retired Reserve closing reconciliation is the termination credit taken bill by bill: for each bill taken in, the days of its period after the termination date, multiplied by the bill's daily amount, with nothing taken off for credits already standing; each bill's figure is rounded to the cent and the figures are added.

- **Termination date.** The termination date the Retired Reserve closing reconciliation works from is the later of the date asked for in the pending request and the date that request was taken.
- **Closing period.** The closing period is the most recently paid coverage month (the coverage month of the bill that the latest posted premium payment on the plan settles) and, where a later coverage month has been billed, that latest-billed month (the coverage month of the plan's monthly bill with the latest due date); the Retired Reserve closing reconciliation takes in the monthly bill and the coverage-type adjustment bill of each month of the closing period, each for the days of its own period, which end on the last day of its month.
- **Daily amount.** Each monthly bill taken in has as its daily amount the amount billed divided by the days the bill covers, credited back where a payment stands against it and withdrawn where none does; each coverage-type adjustment bill taken in has as its daily amount the part of it still unpaid divided by the days it covers, the part paid on it coming back through the monthly bill of its month.
- **Days of a bill's period after the termination date.** The days of the bill's own period that follow the termination date, through the last day of its month; where the termination date falls before the period began, every day of the period.
- **Total.** The Retired Reserve closing reconciliation is the sum, over the bills taken in, of what each bill brings in; what each bill brings in is rounded to the cent and never less than zero, and the sum is rounded to the cent and never less than zero.

*Hypothetical:* a TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-Only plan; the latest payment settled the May monthly bill of 614.07 (31 days); the June monthly bill of 614.07 (30 days) is billed and unpaid; there are no adjustment bills. The pending request asks for 12 May and was taken on 19 May, so the termination date is 19 May. The May bill counts 20 to 31 May, 12 days: 12 multiplied by 614.07, divided by 31, is 237.7045, rounded to 237.70. The June bill's whole period follows the termination date: 30 multiplied by 614.07, divided by 30, is 614.07. The figures added give 851.77.
